==Proto-Semitic==

===Etymology===
Reconstructed in Militarev & Kogan's ''Semitic Etymological Dictionary'' as {{m|sem-pro|*gi/ald-}}. The SED notes that Akkadian {{m|akk|gildu}} is, according to von Soden, from Aramaic, and that the only attested Hebrew form, the hapax {{m|hbo|גלדי|tr=gildī}} "my skin" (Job 16:15), is usually considered an Aramaic borrowing.

===Noun===
{{sem-noun|m}}

# [[skin]], [[hide]]
